textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 5 evs · The Mystery of Food · Textbook Concepts
textbookBox.concept: Detective Disha wants to solve the mystery. Her elder brother Aditya tells her that the coloured patches are mould. Mould is made up of a colony of thousands of tiny living things called microbes.

1.tip: Look closely at the diagram on the board as we explain each property.

beats.en: Detective Disha wants to solve the mystery. Her elder brother Aditya tells her that the coloured patches are mould. Mould is made up of a colony of thousands of tiny living things called microbes.
beats.speakEn: Detective Disha wants to solve the mystery. Her elder brother Aditya tells her that the coloured patches are mould. Mould is made up of a colony of thousands of tiny living things called microbes.

beats.en: Microbes are so tiny that we need a microscope to see them. They are found in soil, water, the air around us, in plants, animals and even inside us.
beats.speakEn: Microbes are so tiny that we need a microscope to see them. They are found in soil, water, the air around us, in plants, animals and even inside us.

type: Key Concept: Detective Disha wants to solve the mystery.
Rule: Microbes are so tiny that we need a microscope to see them.

textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 5 evs · The Mystery of Food · Deeper Textbook Ideas
textbookBox.concept: Some microbes help us, for example in making curd and in digesting food. Others change the taste and smell of food, as in the uttapam.

beats.en: Some microbes help us, for example in making curd and in digesting food. Others change the taste and smell of food, as in the uttapam.
beats.speakEn: Some microbes help us, for example in making curd and in digesting food. Others change the taste and smell of food, as in the uttapam.

beats.en: Why do some foods spoil faster? A slice of bread left outside got coloured patches in two days, but pickles made two months ago were still good, because they were covered with oil.
beats.speakEn: Why do some foods spoil faster? A slice of bread left outside got coloured patches in two days, but pickles made two months ago were still good, because they were covered with oil.

type: Some microbes help us, for example in making curd and in digesting food.

textbookBox.concept: Microbes need moisture, air and the right temperature to grow. If we remove any one of these we can stop them in their tracks.
